bullets.text: In Tiruvallur, angry residents blocked roads at midnight due to continuous power cuts, and the office should monitor power restoration.

Minister Pussai Anand inaugurated a drug awareness marathon organized by traders in Besant Nagar, Chennai, and the office should note youth participation.
Parents and students in Mambakkam Colony near Thiruvallur fear venomous creatures due to an overgrown school campus, requiring office intervention.
Damaged slabs on the Manavalanagar ROB put Tiruvallur residents at risk, and the office should urge the State Highways department to fix it.
A detailed project report is ready for the new Guduvanchery to Avadi railway line to reduce traffic, and the office should track progress.
The Tamil Nadu government plans to use AI across urban bodies to resolve public grievances in one place, and the portfolio team should oversee implementation.
NITK Director stated that AI must be integrated into work while keeping ethics and social responsibility central, which the office should note.
Quad foreign ministers agreed to provide technical assistance to expand trusted AI access across the Indo-Pacific, and the office should watch partnerships.
